name: Highland Links
architects: Willard Small (c. 1892); redesigned by J. Henry McKinley (1913)

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, project MA_CentralEastern_2021_B21 (lidar flown 20 Mar - 24 Apr 2021), tile x41y466; EPSG:26919 (NAD83 / UTM 19N), NAVD88 metres; downloaded by the developer 2026-10-18 (GitHub release data-highland-links)

laz.source: 2021 USGS Lidar: Central Eastern Massachusetts (NOAA Data Access Viewer dataset 9777, job J1471981), clipped to the course box, vegetation classes 4 and 5 only; NAD83(2011) UTM 19N US survey feet, NAVD88 metres; ordered by the developer 2026-10-18 (GitHub release data-highland-links)
laz.label: 2021 USGS lidar, leaf-off

world.note: course boundary bbox (780 x 558 m) + scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks: 1024 m east-west (~120 m each side), 768 m north-south (114 m south, 96 m north) so the whole world lies inside the clipped lidar (y 4654018-4654899)

scorecard_source: Club scorecard PDF (highlandlinkscapecod.com, HighlandLinks-Scorecard.pdf, Feb 2020), identical to the developer's image of the printed card; checked 2026-10-18. Built as 9 holes from the Blue tees (front nine of the card); the card's back nine (White tees) is not used (developer, 2026-10-18). Full card in scorecard_full.csv. Rating/slope 67.2/116 = the club website's 18-hole men's Blue/White figure (developer's choice; the printed card says 67.0/114)

green_tiers.note: developer 2026-10-18: iconic two-tiered green, left side lower, right side higher, about a 3 ft drop

attribution: Elevation and lidar: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (2021 Central Eastern Massachusetts lidar)
notes: Phase 1 decisions (developer, 2026-10-18): 9-hole course, Blue tees only, card pars win over OSM (holes 2 and 6 are par 5), out of bounds = course boundary only, new coastal theme, wind 3-14 mph. dtm / laz entries are added when the data arrives.
